import { describe, expect, it, test } from "vitest";

describe.only("selected", () => {
  it.skip("is named the same as an unskipped one", () => {
    expect(1).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe.each([[1], [2]])("row %i", () => {
  it("is named under a describe nothing can name", () => {
    expect(1).toBe(1);
  });
});

test("carries an escape \" nothing decodes", () => {
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});

it.concurrent.skip("two stacked modifiers still name it", () => {
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});

it.concurrent.each([[1], [2]])("row %i behind two modifiers", (n) => {
  expect(n).toBe(n);
});

it.skipIf(process.platform === "win32")("runs only where the condition allows it", () => {
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});

wrapper(() => {
  it("nested inside a call this table does not recognise", () => {
    expect(1).toBe(1);
  });
});

it("outer test", () => {
  it("nested inside another test's callback", () => {
    expect(1).toBe(1);
  });
});

it("", () => {
  expect(1).toBe(1);
});
